title: The dimmed watch keeps its processor awake for every whole rest
what: When the watch's own dim state is on (Always-on display on) and a rest runs, the app holds the processor awake for the whole rest, plus 5 seconds, so the dim countdown can change every second. In a workout that is mostly rests, the processor stays awake for most of the workout, while the watch would normally sleep and redraw the dim screen once a minute. This was chosen on purpose so the dim countdown shows real seconds. The cost to the battery was never measured.
expected: The battery cost of a one-second dim countdown is measured on a real watch over a full workout. If it is high, the dim screen redraws less often (for example every 10 s, then every second for the last 10 s).
who: members with a watch and Always-on display on
fix_line: Measure the battery cost over a full workout. If it is high, redraw the dim countdown less often until the last seconds

title: The bright rest screen redraws 4 to 5 times a second although its numbers change once a second
what: On the bright screen, the rest countdown wakes up every 0.2 s and the Rest is over count-up every 0.25 s, so the screen is redrawn 4 to 5 times for each change of the seconds shown. On the app's own dim screen, the same loop already waits for the next whole second. The extra redraws cost a little battery on every rest the member looks at.
expected: The bright countdown and count-up wake once per shown second, in step with the digits, as the dim screen already does.
how_often: every rest while the screen is bright
fix_line: Wait for the next whole second on the bright screen too, as the dim screen already does

the watch shows one workout's current set and rest only; it holds no member lists or big pages
the phone app is another area; the watch keeps no workout history, only the next set the phone sends
